title: Monoidal total tensor on the homotopy category
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a monoidal structure $(\otimes,\mathbf1)$ [def-sfb-monoidal-category] additive in each variable. Assume that $C$ has all small colimits and that tensoring with any object on either side preserves them. On unbounded cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], use the direct-sum total tensor of [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso], with differential $d(x\otimes y)=d(x)\otimes y+(-1)^p x\otimes d(y)$ on bidegree $(p,q)$. This tensor defines a monoidal structure on $\mathrm{CoCh}(C)$ with unit $\mathbf1[0]$, associator induced by reindexing triple direct sums and the associator of $C$, and the corresponding unitors. Here $K(C)$ has complexes as objects and cochain maps modulo cochain homotopy as morphisms: $f,g:X\to Y$ are homotopic if there are $h^n:X^n\to Y^{n-1}$ with $f^n-g^n=d_Y^{n-1}h^n+h^{n+1}d_X^n$ for all $n$. The total tensor passes to these classes, giving a monoidal structure on $K(C)$ for which the quotient $\mathrm{CoCh}(C)\to K(C)$ is strong monoidal [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]. In particular the associator and unitors on $K(C)$ satisfy pentagon and triangle and are the images of those on complexes.
